difficulty_reason: The authored proof translates failure of a bounded-round disjoint-disjunction search into consistency of a nonstandard universal-arithmetic theory via KPT witnessing. It constructs a formula with no proof in any standard propositional proof system and uses a two-stage model extension preserving Sigma-b-one properties and lengths to force a short proof and a falsifying assignment into the same sound model. Both student-teacher hardness and the open Problem2.2 model-extension hypothesis are indispensable explicit conditions; the claimed conclusion is a conditional complexity separation, not an unconditional solution to NP versus coNP.
